collection.title: VW Scirocco 2008 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Scirocco Coupe 2008 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Scirocco, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
